findings.title: First-part promotion can permanently stall an idle dispatcher
findings.impact: A drop with at least twelve new first-part jobs can stop all selected non-probe work.
findings.input: Refuse an older continuation for memory; release its holder; enqueue twelve younger first parts.
findings.proof: After 120001 ms all twelve selected jobs are blocked by the older off-window refusal.
findings.observed: No reservations and no admissions at 120001, 180001 or 3600000 ms; refusal remains queued.
findings.baseline: Removing only first_part DESC returns the older continuation first and restores reachability.
findings.expectedFailure: idle dispatcher must admit at least one ready job
findings.next: Make an aged resource refusal reachable before applying the first-part priority/window limit.

findings.title: Draining the unread line tail never renews the reader attempt
findings.impact: A large NDJSON tail taking over 180 seconds cannot seal, despite continuing byte progress.
findings.input: 183 replays of the first public Uttam feature, arriving one line per simulated second.
findings.proof: Unchanged worker algorithm with external effects faked and existing parser limit lowered to one.
findings.observed: 182000 ms: limit 1 gives zero heartbeats, zero published slots and no accepted result.
findings.baseline: Same bytes/timing, limit 500000: six heartbeats, two slots and accepted result.
findings.productionCase: At the real 500000-record ceiling, a continually arriving tail lasting >180 s is enough.
findings.expectedFailure: a progressing unread tail must not expire its reader attempt
findings.next: Renew the fenced attempt while draining bytes, without parsing or allocating tail records.

findings.title: An own draft can commit between the package rule and original publication
findings.impact: A sibling original can be retained into a case whose existing package has just committed.
path: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/service.ts:54-69 locks the case, not the admitted packages.
findings.input: A REVIEWED geometry package cites its case's intake source; a sibling v1 receipt is finalizing.
findings.proof: Run the actual receipt service; interleave a package commit after its last workspace check.
findings.lockAudit: GIS commit takes no source-case lock; package-authority.ts:8-40 takes no replacement lock.
findings.observed: Package COMMITTED, receipt retained, one new source; no package read requested a row lock.
findings.limits: Deterministic SQL-protocol interleaving plus exact lock audit, not a live PostgreSQL run.
findings.expectedFailure: source publication must not overtake a package commit
findings.next: Serialize admitted-draft state changes with receipt publication using a consistent lock order.
